sentences.zh: 推天正十一月經朔加時入交：置天正十一月朔積分，以交終分秒去之，不盡，滿樞法為日，不滿為餘秒，即天正經朔加時入交泛日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To derive entry into conjunction at hour-of-addition for the civil new-year eleventh-month month-beginning: set the civil new-year eleventh-month month-beginning accumulated parts; remove conjunction terminal parts and seconds; what does not exhaust, when full of the pivot divisor counts as days, what does not fill is remainder seconds—that is the generalized conjunction day and remainder seconds at hour-of-addition for the civil new-year month-beginning.
translations.idiomatic: To derive entry into conjunction at hour-of-addition for the eleventh-month month-beginning at civil new year: set the accumulated parts for that month-beginning, discard full conjunction terminal parts and seconds, divide the remainder by the pivot divisor for days with the remainder as parts and seconds, and obtain the generalized conjunction day and remainder in seconds at hour-of-addition for the civil new-year month-beginning.

sentences.zh: 求次朔及望入交：因天正經朔加時入交泛日及餘秒，求次朔，以朔差日及餘秒加之；

translations.literal: To find the next month-beginning and full moon entering conjunction: from the civil new-year month-beginning hour-of-addition generalized conjunction day and remainder seconds, for the next month-beginning add the new-moon discrepancy day and remainder seconds;
translations.idiomatic: To find the next month-beginning and full moon entering conjunction: starting from the civil new-year month-beginning generalized conjunction day and remainder seconds at hour-of-addition, for the next month-beginning add the new-moon discrepancy in days and remainder seconds;

sentences.zh: 求望，以望策及餘秒加之：滿交終日及餘秒皆去之，即次朔及望加時所入。

translations.literal: To find the full moon: add the full-moon stride and its remainder-seconds; when full, remove the crossing termination day and remainder-seconds — that is the hour-of-addition entry for the next month-beginning and full moon.
translations.idiomatic: To find the full moon, add the full-moon stride and remainder-seconds; cast out full crossing-termination days and remainder-seconds to obtain the hour-of-addition entry for the next month-beginning and full moon.

sentences.zh: 若以經朔、望小餘減之，即各得朔、望夜半入交泛日及餘秒。

translations.literal: If one subtracts the mean month-beginning and full-moon minor remainders, each yields the month-beginning and full-moon midnight general crossing day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Subtracting each mean syzygy's minor remainder yields the general crossing day and remainder-seconds at midnight for that month-beginning or full moon.

sentences.zh: 求定朔夜半入交：因經朔、望夜半入交，若定朔、望大餘有進退者，亦進退交日，不則因經為定，各得所求。

translations.literal: To find fixed month-beginning midnight entry into crossing: from mean month-beginning and full-moon midnight entry into crossing, if the fixed month-beginning or full-moon major remainder has advance or retreat, advance or retreat the crossing day likewise; otherwise take the mean as fixed — each yields what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed month-beginning midnight crossing entry: start from mean syzygy midnight crossing; if the fixed syzygy's major remainder advances or retreats, adjust the crossing day accordingly, otherwise use the mean value as fixed.

sentences.zh: 求次定朔夜半入交：各因前定朔夜半入交，大月加日二，小月加日一，餘皆加八千三百四十二、秒五千七百二十三；

translations.literal: To find the next fixed month-beginning midnight entry into crossing: from each prior fixed month-beginning midnight entry into crossing, in a long month add two days, in a short month one day; to the remainder always add 8,342, 5,723 seconds;
translations.idiomatic: For the next fixed month-beginning midnight crossing entry: from each prior fixed month-beginning midnight entry, add two days in a long month and one in a short month, and always add 8,342 remainder and 5,723 seconds.

sentences.zh: 若求次日，累加一日：滿交終日及餘秒皆去之，即得次定朔及每日夜半入交泛日及餘秒。

translations.literal: If seeking the next day, accumulate one day: when full remove the crossing termination day and remainder-seconds — that is the next fixed month-beginning and each day's midnight general crossing day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To advance day by day, add one day cumulatively, cast out full crossing-termination days and remainder-seconds, and obtain the next fixed month-beginning and each day's midnight general crossing day and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 求朔望加時入交常日：置經朔、望入交泛日及餘秒，以其朔、望入氣朏朒定數，朏減朒加之，即朔、望入交常日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To find month-beginning and full-moon hour-of-addition entry into crossing regular day: set the mean month-beginning and full-moon general crossing day and remainder-seconds; with that month-beginning or full-moon entry-into-qi waxing-waning fixed number, waxing subtract waning add — that is the month-beginning and full-moon entry into crossing regular day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find syzygy hour-of-addition regular crossing day: set mean syzygy general crossing day and remainder-seconds, apply entry-into-qi waxing-waning fixed numbers (waxing subtract, waning add), and obtain syzygy regular crossing day and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 求朔望加時入交定日：置其朔、望入轉朏朒定數，以交率乘之，如交數而一，所得，以朏減朒加入交常日余，滿若不足，進退其日，即朔、望加時入交定日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To find month-beginning and full-moon hour-of-addition entry into crossing fixed day: set its month-beginning or full-moon entry-into-rotation waxing-waning fixed number; multiply by the crossing rate, one per crossing number; with the result waxing subtract waning add to the regular crossing day remainder; when full or insufficient, advance or retreat the day — that is the month-beginning and full-moon hour-of-addition entry into crossing fixed day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find syzygy hour-of-addition fixed crossing day: set entry-into-rotation waxing-waning fixed number, multiply by crossing rate and divide by crossing number, waxing subtract and waning add to the regular crossing remainder, adjust the day as needed, and obtain fixed crossing day and remainder-seconds at hour-of-addition.

sentences.zh: 求月行入陰陽曆：視其朔、望入交定日及餘秒，在中日及餘秒以下者為月在陽曆；

translations.literal: To find the moon's entry into yin-yang calendar: inspect the month-beginning and full-moon entry into crossing fixed day and remainder-seconds; if at or below the middle day and remainder-seconds, the moon is in the solar-path;
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's solar-path or lunar-path: if the syzygy's fixed crossing day and remainder-seconds are at or below the middle day and remainder-seconds, the moon is in the solar-path;

sentences.zh: 如中日及餘秒已上者，減去之，為月在陰曆。

translations.literal: if at or above the middle day and remainder-seconds, subtract it — the moon is in the lunar-path.
translations.idiomatic: if at or above the middle day and remainder-seconds, subtract the middle day; the moon is in the lunar-path.

sentences.zh: 凡入交定日，陽初陰末為交初，陰初陽末為交中。

translations.literal: Whenever one enters a crossing fixed day: solar-path initial and lunar-path final is crossing beginning; lunar-path initial and solar-path final is crossing middle.
translations.idiomatic: For fixed crossing days: solar-path at the start and lunar-path at the end marks crossing beginning; lunar-path at the start and solar-path at the end marks crossing middle.

sentences.zh: 求朔望加時月入陰陽曆積度：置其月入陰陽曆日及余，其餘，先以一百乘之，樞法除為約分。

translations.literal: To find month-beginning and full-moon hour-of-addition moon's entry into yin-yang calendar accumulated degrees: set its moon's entry into yin-yang calendar day and remainder; to the remainder first multiply by 100, divide by the pivot divisor for simplified parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find syzygy hour accumulated solar-path or lunar-path degrees: set the moon's entered yin-yang day and remainder, multiply the remainder by 100, and divide by the pivot divisor to obtain simplified parts.

sentences.zh: 以九百九乘之，六十八除為度，不盡，退除為分，即朔、望加時月入陰陽曆積度及分。

translations.literal: Multiply by 999, divide by 68 for degrees; what does not exhaust, retreat-divide for parts — that is the month-beginning and full-moon hour-of-addition moon's entry into yin-yang calendar accumulated degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by 999, divide by 68 for degrees, reduce any remainder to parts, and obtain syzygy hour accumulated solar-path or lunar-path degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 其月在陽曆，即為入陽曆積度；

translations.literal: If the moon is in the solar-path, that is entry into solar-path accumulated degrees;
translations.idiomatic: If the moon is in the solar-path, this is solar-path accumulated degrees;

sentences.zh: 月在陰曆，即為入陰曆積度。

translations.literal: if the moon is in the lunar-path, that is entry into lunar-path accumulated degrees.
translations.idiomatic: if the moon is in the lunar-path, this is lunar-path accumulated degrees.

sentences.zh: 求朔望加時月去黃道度：置入陰陽曆積度及分，如交象以下為在少象；

translations.literal: To find month-beginning and full-moon hour-of-addition moon's departure from the Yellow Path in degrees: set the entered yin-yang calendar accumulated degrees and parts; if at or below the crossing image, it is in the young image;
translations.idiomatic: To find syzygy hour lunar latitude: set entered yin-yang accumulated degrees and parts; at or below the crossing image counts as the young image;

sentences.zh: 已上，覆減半交，餘為入老象。

translations.literal: if above, cover and subtract half-crossing; the remainder is entry into the old image.
translations.idiomatic: if above, cover and subtract half-crossing; the remainder is entry into the old image.

sentences.zh: 置所入老少象度及分，以五因之，用減一千一十，餘，以老少象度及分乘之，八十四而一，列於上位；

translations.literal: Set the entered young or old image degrees and parts above, multiply by five, subtract from 1,010; multiply the remainder by the young or old image degrees and parts, one per 84, and array above;
translations.idiomatic: Set entered young or old image degrees and parts, multiply by five, subtract from 1,010, multiply the remainder by the image degrees and parts, divide by 84, and place in the upper row;

sentences.zh: 又置所入老少象度及分，如半象以下為在初限；

translations.literal: Again set the entered young or old image degrees and parts; if at or below half an image, it is in the initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: Again set entered young or old image degrees and parts; at or below half an image counts as the initial limit;

sentences.zh: 已上，減去半象，餘為入末限。

translations.literal: if above, subtract half an image; the remainder is entry into the final limit.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract half an image; the remainder is entry into the final limit.

sentences.zh: 置初、末限底及分於上，列半象度及分於下，以上減下，餘以乘上，四十而一，所得，初限以減，末限以加，上位滿百為度，不滿為分，即朔、望加時月去黃道度數及分。

translations.literal: Set initial and final limit base degrees and parts above and array half-image degrees and parts below; subtract below from above, multiply the remainder by above, one per 40; for the initial limit subtract, for the final limit add; when the upper row fills 100 that makes degrees, what does not fill is parts — that is the month-beginning and full-moon hour-of-addition moon's departure from the Yellow Path in degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Place initial and final limit bases above and half-image degrees below, subtract and multiply (divide by 40), subtract for the initial limit and add for the final limit, convert hundreds to degrees, and obtain syzygy hour lunar latitude in degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 求食定餘：置定朔小餘，如半法以下覆加半法，餘為午前分；

translations.literal: To find eclipse-fixed remainder: set the fixed month-beginning minor remainder; if at or below the half method, cover and add the half method — the remainder is the before-noon part;
translations.idiomatic: To find the eclipse-fixed remainder: set the fixed month-beginning minor remainder; if at or below the half method, add back the half method to obtain the before-noon fraction;

sentences.zh: 已上，減去半法，餘為午後分。

translations.literal: if above, subtract the half method; the remainder is the after-noon part.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract the half method to obtain the after-noon fraction.

sentences.zh: 置午前、後分於上，列半法於下，以上減下，以下乘上，午前以三萬一千七百七十除，午後以一萬三千八百八十五除之，各為時差。

translations.literal: Set the before- and after-noon parts above and array the half method below; subtract below from above, multiply below by above; before noon divide by 31,770, after noon divide by 13,885 — each is the time difference.
translations.idiomatic: Place before- and after-noon parts above and the half method below, subtract and multiply, divide before-noon by 31,770 and after-noon by 13,885, and obtain the time difference for each.

sentences.zh: 午前以減、午後以加定朔小餘，各為食定小餘。

translations.literal: Before noon subtract, after noon add to the fixed month-beginning minor remainder — each is the eclipse-fixed minor remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the time difference before noon and add it after noon to the fixed month-beginning minor remainder to obtain the eclipse-fixed minor remainder.

sentences.zh: 以時差加午前、後分，為午前、後定分。

translations.literal: Add the time difference to the before- and after-noon parts — that is the before- and after-noon fixed parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add the time difference to the before- and after-noon parts to obtain the before- and after-noon fixed parts.

sentences.zh: 其月食，直以定望小餘便為食定小餘。

translations.literal: For a lunar eclipse, directly take the fixed full-moon minor remainder as the eclipse-fixed minor remainder.
translations.idiomatic: For a lunar eclipse, the fixed full-moon minor remainder itself serves as the eclipse-fixed minor remainder.

sentences.zh: 求日月食甚辰刻：置食定小餘，以辰法除之為辰數，不滿，進一位，刻法除之為刻，不滿為刻分。

translations.literal: To find solar and lunar eclipse-greatest watch and quarter: set the eclipse-fixed minor remainder; divide by the watch divisor for watch count; what does not fill, advance one place, divide by the quarter divisor for quarters; what does not fill is quarter parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find eclipse maximum watch and quarter: divide the eclipse-fixed minor remainder by the watch divisor for watches, advance the remainder one place and divide by the quarter divisor for quarters, and obtain quarter parts.

sentences.zh: 其辰數命子正，算外，即食甚辰、刻及分。

translations.literal: Name the watch count from zi-zheng, outside the count — that is the eclipse-greatest watch, quarter, and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Count watches from zi-zheng, outside the count, to obtain eclipse maximum watch, quarter, and parts.

sentences.zh: 求氣差：置其朔中積，滿二至限去之，餘在一象以下為在初；

translations.literal: To find qi difference: set its new-moon middle accumulation; remove what fills the two-solstice limit; if the remainder is at or below one image, it is in the initial;
translations.idiomatic: To find qi difference: set the new-moon middle accumulation, cast out the two-solstice limit, and if the remainder is at or below one image it is initial;

sentences.zh: 已上，覆減二至限，餘為在末。

translations.literal: if above, cover and subtract the two-solstice limit; the remainder is in the final.
translations.idiomatic: if above, cover and subtract the two-solstice limit; the remainder is final.

sentences.zh: 皆自相乘，進二位，滿二百三十六除之，用減三千五百三十三，為氣差。

translations.literal: In each case square itself, advance two places, one per 236 — use the result to subtract from 3,533; the remainder is qi difference.
translations.idiomatic: Square each case, shift two places, divide by 236, subtract from 3,533, and obtain qi difference.

sentences.zh: 以乘距午定分，半晝分而一，所得以減氣差，為定數。

translations.literal: Multiply by the noon-distance fixed parts, one per half day-part; subtract the result from qi difference — that is the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the noon-distance fixed parts, divide by half day-part, subtract from qi difference, and obtain the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 春分後，交初以減，交中以加；

translations.literal: After the spring equinox, at crossing beginning subtract, at crossing middle add;
translations.idiomatic: After the spring equinox: subtract at crossing beginning and add at crossing middle;

sentences.zh: 秋分後，交初以加，交中以減。

translations.literal: after the autumn equinox, at crossing beginning add, at crossing middle subtract.
translations.idiomatic: after the autumn equinox: add at crossing beginning and subtract at crossing middle.

sentences.zh: 求刻差：置其朔中積，滿二至限去之，餘，列二至限於下，以上減下，餘以乘上，進二位，滿二百三十六除之，為刻差以乘距午定分，四因之，樞法而一，為定數。

translations.literal: To find quarter difference: set its new-moon middle accumulation; remove what fills the two-solstice limit; array the two-solstice limit below, subtract below from above, multiply the remainder by above, advance two places, one per 236 — that is quarter difference; multiply by the noon-distance fixed parts, multiply by four, one per pivot divisor — that is the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: To find quarter difference: set new-moon middle accumulation, cast out two-solstice limit, subtract and multiply against the limit (divide by 236), multiply by noon-distance fixed parts, multiply by four, divide by the pivot divisor, and obtain the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 冬至後食甚在午前，夏至後食甚在午後。

translations.literal: After the winter solstice, if eclipse-greatest is before noon; after the summer solstice, if eclipse-greatest is after noon.
translations.idiomatic: After the winter solstice, eclipse maximum falls before noon; after the summer solstice, it falls after noon.

sentences.zh: 交初以加，交中以減。

translations.literal: At crossing beginning add, at crossing middle subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add at crossing beginning and subtract at crossing middle.

sentences.zh: 冬至後食甚在午後，夏至後食甚在午前。

translations.literal: After the winter solstice, if eclipse-greatest is after noon; after the summer solstice, if eclipse-greatest is before noon.
translations.idiomatic: After the winter solstice, eclipse maximum falls after noon; after the summer solstice, it falls before noon.

sentences.zh: 交初以加，交中以減。

translations.literal: At crossing beginning add, at crossing middle subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add at crossing beginning and subtract at crossing middle.

sentences.zh: 求日入食限：置入交定日及餘秒，以氣、刻、時三差定數各加減之，如中日及餘秒以下為不食；

translations.literal: To find solar entry into the eclipse limit: set entry into crossing fixed day and remainder-seconds; with the qi-, quarter-, and time-difference fixed numbers each add or subtract; if at or below the middle day and remainder-seconds, there is no eclipse;
translations.idiomatic: To find solar entry into the eclipse limit: set fixed crossing day and remainder-seconds, apply qi-, quarter-, and time-difference fixed numbers, and if at or below the middle day and remainder-seconds there is no eclipse;

sentences.zh: 已上者，減去中日及餘秒，如後限以下、前限已上為入食限；

translations.literal: if above, subtract the middle day and remainder-seconds; if at or below the rear limit and at or above the forward limit, it has entered the eclipse limit;
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract the middle day and remainder-seconds; if at or below the rear limit and at or above the forward limit, the syzygy has entered the eclipse limit;

sentences.zh: 後限以下為交後分；

translations.literal: at or below the rear limit is the after-crossing part;
translations.idiomatic: at or below the rear limit is the after-crossing part;

sentences.zh: 前限以上覆減中日，餘為交前分。

translations.literal: at or above the forward limit, cover and subtract the middle day; the remainder is the before-crossing part.
translations.idiomatic: at or above the forward limit, cover and subtract the middle day; the remainder is the before-crossing part.

sentences.zh: 求日食分：置入交前後分，如陽曆食限以下者為陽曆食定分；

translations.literal: To find solar eclipse parts: set the before- and after-crossing parts; if at or below the solar-path eclipse limit, that is the solar-path eclipse fixed part;
translations.idiomatic: To find solar eclipse magnitude: set before- and after-crossing parts; if at or below the solar-path eclipse limit, that is the solar-path eclipse fixed part;

sentences.zh: 已上者，覆減一萬一千二百，餘為陰曆食定分；

translations.literal: if above, cover and subtract 11,200; the remainder is the lunar-path eclipse fixed part;
translations.idiomatic: if above, cover and subtract 11,200; the remainder is the lunar-path eclipse fixed part;

sentences.zh: 不足減者，不食。

translations.literal: if insufficient to subtract, there is no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: if subtraction cannot be completed, there is no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 各如限陽曆定法而一，為食之大分，不盡，退除為小分，半已上為半強，半以下為半弱。

translations.literal: In each case, one per the limit solar-path fixed divisor, is the eclipse major part; what does not exhaust, retreat-divide for minor parts; half or above is half-strong, below half is half-weak.
translations.idiomatic: Divide each by the solar-path fixed divisor to obtain the eclipse major part, reduce any remainder to minor parts, and treat half or above as half-strong and below half as half-weak.

sentences.zh: 命大分以十為限，得日食之分。

translations.literal: Count the major part with ten as limit — obtain the solar eclipse part.
translations.idiomatic: Take the major part on a scale of ten to obtain solar eclipse magnitude.

sentences.zh: 求日食泛用分：置朔入陰陽曆食定分，一百約之，在陽曆者列入十四於下，在陰曆者列一百四十於下，各以上減下，餘以乘上，進二位，陽曆以一百八十五除，陰曆以五百一十四除，各為日食泛用分。

translations.literal: To find solar eclipse general use-parts: set the month-beginning entry into yin-yang calendar eclipse fixed part, hundred-reduce it; in the solar-path array 14 below, in the lunar-path array 140 below; in each case subtract below from above, multiply the remainder by above, advance two places; solar-path divide by 185, lunar-path divide by 514 — each is the solar eclipse general use-part.
translations.idiomatic: To find solar eclipse general use-parts: set month-beginning yin-yang eclipse fixed part and hundred-reduce; for solar-path place 14 below and for lunar-path 140 below, subtract and multiply (shift two places), divide by 185 (solar-path) or 514 (lunar-path), and obtain solar eclipse general use-parts.

sentences.zh: 求月入食限：視月入陰陽曆日及餘，如後限以下為交後分；

translations.literal: To find lunar entry into the eclipse limit: inspect the moon's entry into yin-yang calendar day and remainder; if at or below the rear limit, that is the after-crossing part;
translations.idiomatic: To find lunar entry into the eclipse limit: inspect the moon's yin-yang day and remainder; if at or below the rear limit, that is the after-crossing part;

sentences.zh: 前限已上覆減中日，為交前分。

translations.literal: at or above the forward limit, cover and subtract the middle day — that is the before-crossing part.
translations.idiomatic: at or above the forward limit, cover and subtract the middle day to obtain the before-crossing part.

sentences.zh: 求月食分：置交前後分，如三千二百以下者，食既；

translations.literal: To find lunar eclipse parts: set the before- and after-crossing parts; if at or below 3,200, the eclipse is total;
translations.idiomatic: To find lunar eclipse magnitude: set before- and after-crossing parts; if at or below 3,200, the eclipse is total;

sentences.zh: 已上，用減一萬二百，不足減者不食；

translations.literal: if above, subtract 10,200; if insufficient to subtract, there is no eclipse;
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract 10,200; if subtraction cannot be completed, there is no eclipse;

sentences.zh: 餘以七百除之為大分，不盡，退除為小分，小分半已上為半強，半已下為半弱。

translations.literal: divide the remainder by 700 for the major part; what does not exhaust, retreat-divide for minor parts; minor parts half or above are half-strong, half or below are half-weak.
translations.idiomatic: divide the remainder by 700 for the major part, reduce any remainder to minor parts, and treat half or above as half-strong and half or below as half-weak.

sentences.zh: 命大分以十為限，得月食之分。

translations.literal: Count the major part with ten as limit — obtain the lunar eclipse part.
translations.idiomatic: Take the major part on a scale of ten to obtain lunar eclipse magnitude.

sentences.zh: 求月食泛用分：置望入交前後分，退一等，自相乘，交初以九百三十五除，交中以一千一百五十六除之，得數用減刻率，交初以一千一百一十一為刻率，交中以九百為刻率。

translations.literal: To find lunar eclipse general use-parts: set the full-moon entry into crossing before- and after-crossing parts, retreat one place, square; at crossing beginning divide by 935, at crossing middle divide by 1,156; use the result to subtract from the quarter rate — at crossing beginning the quarter rate is 1,111, at crossing middle it is 900.
translations.idiomatic: To find lunar eclipse general use-parts: set full-moon before- and after-crossing parts, shift one place and square, divide by 935 (crossing beginning) or 1,156 (crossing middle), and subtract from the quarter rate of 1,111 (crossing beginning) or 900 (crossing middle).

sentences.zh: 各得所求。

translations.literal: Each yields what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Each procedure yields the value sought.

sentences.zh: 求日月食定用分：置日月食泛用分，以一千三百三十七乘之，以所食日轉定分除之，即得所求。

translations.literal: To find solar and lunar eclipse fixed use-parts: set the solar or lunar eclipse general use-part; multiply by 1,337, divide by the rotation fixed parts of the day eclipsed — that is what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: To find eclipse fixed use-parts: multiply general use-parts by 1,337 and divide by the rotation fixed parts of the eclipse day to obtain the fixed use-part.

sentences.zh: 求日月食虧初復滿小餘：各以定用分減食甚小餘，為虧初；

translations.literal: To find solar and lunar eclipse first diminishment, restoration fullness, and minor remainders: for each subtract the fixed use-part from the eclipse-greatest minor remainder — that is first diminishment;
translations.idiomatic: To find eclipse first diminishment, restoration fullness, and minor remainders: subtract the fixed use-part from the eclipse-greatest minor remainder for first diminishment;

sentences.zh: 加食甚小餘，為復滿：即各得虧初復滿小餘。

translations.literal: add the eclipse-greatest minor remainder — that is restoration fullness: then each obtains first diminishment and restoration fullness minor remainders.
translations.idiomatic: add the fixed use-part to the eclipse-greatest minor remainder for restoration fullness; each case then yields first diminishment and restoration fullness minor remainders.

sentences.zh: 若求時刻者，依食甚術入之。

translations.literal: If seeking the hour mark, enter by the eclipse-greatest procedure.
translations.idiomatic: To find clock time, apply the eclipse-greatest procedure.

sentences.zh: 求月食更籌定法：置其望晨分，四因之，退一等，為更法；

translations.literal: To find lunar eclipse watch-and-tally fixed method: set its full-moon dawn parts, multiply by four, retreat one place — that is the watch method;
translations.idiomatic: To find lunar eclipse watch and tally divisors: quadruple the full-moon dawn parts and shift one place to obtain the watch method;

sentences.zh: 倍之，退一等，為籌法。

translations.literal: double it, retreat one place — that is the tally method.
translations.idiomatic: double that value and shift one place to obtain the tally method.

sentences.zh: 求月食入更籌：置虧初、食甚、復滿小餘，在晨分以下加晨分，昏分已上減去昏分，餘以更法除之為更數，不滿，以籌法除之為籌數。

translations.literal: To find lunar eclipse entry into watch and tally: set first diminishment, eclipse-greatest, and restoration fullness minor remainders; below dawn parts add dawn parts, above dusk parts subtract dusk parts; divide the remainder by the watch method for watch count; what does not fill, divide by the tally method for tally count.
translations.idiomatic: To find lunar eclipse watch and tally entry: set first diminishment, eclipse maximum, and restoration fullness minor remainders; below dawn parts add dawn parts, above dusk parts subtract dusk parts; divide by the watch method for watch count, then by the tally method for tally count.

sentences.zh: 其更數命初更，算外，即各得所入更、籌。

translations.literal: Name the watch count from the first watch, outside the count — then each obtains its entered watch and tally.
translations.idiomatic: Name from the first watch outside the count to obtain each entered watch and tally.

sentences.zh: 求朔、望食甚宿次：置其經朔、望入氣小餘，以入氣、入轉朏朒定數朏減朒加之，乘其日升降分，樞法而一，加減其日盈縮分，至後、分前以加，分後、至前以減。

translations.literal: To find month-beginning and full-moon eclipse-greatest lodge sequence: set its mean month-beginning and full-moon entry-into-qi minor remainder; with entry-into-qi and entry-into-rotation waxing-waning fixed numbers, waxing subtract waning add; multiply that day's ascending-descending parts, one per pivot divisor; add or subtract that day's excess-deficit parts — after the solstice and before the parts add, after the parts and before the solstice subtract.
translations.idiomatic: To find syzygy eclipse-greatest lodge position: set mean syzygy entry-into-qi minor remainder, apply entry-into-qi and entry-into-rotation waxing-waning fixed numbers (waxing subtract, waning add), multiply by that day's ascending-descending parts and divide by the pivot divisor, add or subtract excess-deficit parts (add after solstice and before parts, subtract after parts and before solstice).

sentences.zh: 一百約之為分，分滿百為度，以盈加縮減其定朔、望加時中積，以天正冬至加時黃道日度及分加而命之，即定朔、望加時日躔宿次。

translations.literal: Hundred-reduce for parts; when parts fill 100 that makes degrees; with excess add and deficit subtract to the fixed month-beginning and full-moon hour-of-addition middle accumulation; add to the civil new-year winter solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree and parts and name — that is the fixed month-beginning and full-moon hour-of-addition solar daily-motion lodge sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Hundred-reduce to parts and convert hundreds to degrees, apply excess-add and deficit-subtract to fixed syzygy hour-of-addition middle accumulation, add to the civil new-year winter solstice ecliptic solar degree at hour-of-addition, name the lodges, and obtain fixed syzygy hour-of-addition solar lodge position.

sentences.zh: 其望加半周天，命如前，即朔、望食甚宿次。

translations.literal: At full moon add half a circuit of heaven and name as before — that is the month-beginning and full-moon eclipse-greatest lodge sequence.
translations.idiomatic: At full moon add half a circuit of heaven and name as before to obtain month-beginning and full-moon eclipse-greatest lodge positions.

sentences.zh: 求月食既內外刻分：置月食交前、後分，覆減三千二百，不及減者，為食下既。

translations.literal: To find lunar eclipse total inner and outer quarter parts: set the lunar eclipse before- and after-crossing parts; cover and subtract 3,200; if insufficient to subtract, the eclipse is below totality.
translations.idiomatic: To find lunar eclipse total inner and outer quarter parts: set lunar eclipse before- and after-crossing parts, cover and subtract 3,200; if subtraction cannot be completed, the eclipse falls short of totality.

sentences.zh: 一百約之，列六十四於下，以上減下，餘以乘上，進二位，交初以二百九十三除，交中以三百六十五除，所得，以定用分乘之，如泛用分而一，為月食既內刻分；

translations.literal: Hundred-reduce it, array 64 below, subtract below from above, multiply the remainder by above, advance two places; at crossing beginning divide by 293, at crossing middle divide by 365; multiply the result by the fixed use-part, one per general use-part — that is the lunar eclipse total inner quarter part;
translations.idiomatic: Hundred-reduce, place 64 below, subtract and multiply (shift two places), divide by 293 (crossing beginning) or 365 (crossing middle), multiply by fixed use-parts and divide by general use-parts, and obtain lunar eclipse total inner quarter parts;

sentences.zh: 覆減定用分，即既外刻分。

translations.literal: cover and subtract the fixed use-part — that is the total outer quarter part.
translations.idiomatic: cover and subtract the fixed use-part to obtain the total outer quarter part.

sentences.zh: 求日月帶食出入分數：各以食定小餘與日出、入分相減，餘為帶食差；

translations.literal: To find solar and lunar horizon-partial-eclipse rise-and-set visible fraction: for each set the eclipse-fixed minor remainder and subtract the sun's rise or set parts; the remainder is the horizon-partial-eclipse difference;
translations.idiomatic: To find the visible fraction when an eclipse is caught at sunrise or sunset: subtract rise or set parts from the eclipse-fixed minor remainder to obtain the horizon-partial difference;

sentences.zh: 其帶食差滿定用分已上者，不帶食出入也。

translations.literal: if the horizon-partial-eclipse difference fills the fixed use-part or more, there is no horizon-partial eclipse at rise or set.
translations.idiomatic: if the horizon-partial difference meets or exceeds the fixed use-part, no horizon-partial eclipse occurs at rise or set.

sentences.zh: 以帶食差乘所食分，滿定用分而一，若月食既者，以既內刻分減帶食差，餘所食分，以既外刻分而一，不及減者，為帶食既出入也。

translations.literal: Multiply the horizon-partial-eclipse difference by the fraction eclipsed, one per fixed use-part; if the lunar eclipse is total, subtract the total inner quarter part from the horizon-partial-eclipse difference; with the remainder and fraction eclipsed, one per total outer quarter part; if insufficient to subtract, it is partial totality at rise or set.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the horizon-partial difference by the eclipsed fraction and divide by the fixed use-part; for a total lunar eclipse, subtract the total inner quarter part from the horizon-partial difference, divide the remainder and eclipsed fraction by the total outer quarter part; if subtraction cannot be completed, the eclipse is partially total at rise or set.

sentences.zh: 各以減所食分，即帶出、入所見之分。

translations.literal: Subtract that from the fraction eclipsed — that is the visible fraction at rise or set with horizon partial eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the result from the eclipsed fraction to obtain the visible fraction at rise or set with horizon partial eclipse.

sentences.zh: 其朔日食甚在晝者，晨為漸進之分，昏為已退之分；

translations.literal: When a month-beginning solar eclipse-greatest falls in daytime, dawn is the still-advancing fraction and dusk is the already-retreating fraction;
translations.idiomatic: When a month-beginning solar eclipse maximum falls in daylight, at dawn the eclipse is still advancing and at dusk it has already retreated;

sentences.zh: 若食甚在夜者，晨為已退之分，昏為漸進之分。

translations.literal: if eclipse-greatest falls at night, dawn is the already-retreating fraction and dusk is the still-advancing fraction.
translations.idiomatic: if eclipse maximum falls at night, at dawn it has already retreated and at dusk it is still advancing.

sentences.zh: 其月食者，見此可知也。

translations.literal: For a lunar eclipse, this may be understood by analogy.
translations.idiomatic: For a lunar eclipse, the same principle applies.

sentences.zh: 求日食所起：日在陰曆，初起西北，甚於正北，復于東北；

translations.literal: To find where the solar eclipse begins: when the sun is in the lunar-path, first contact northwest, maximum due north, recovery northeast;
translations.idiomatic: To find solar eclipse direction of first contact: with the sun in the lunar-path, first contact is northwest, maximum due north, and recovery northeast;

sentences.zh: 日在陽曆，初起西南，甚于正南，復于東南。

translations.literal: when the sun is in the solar-path, first contact southwest, maximum due south, recovery southeast.
translations.idiomatic: with the sun in the solar-path, first contact is southwest, maximum due south, and recovery southeast.

sentences.zh: 其食八分已上者，皆起正西，復於正東。

translations.literal: When the eclipse is eight-tenths or more, all begin due west and recover due east.
translations.idiomatic: For eclipses of eight-tenths or greater, first contact is always due west and recovery due east.

sentences.zh: 此據午地而論之，其餘方位，審黃道斜正、月行所向，可知方向。

translations.literal: This is discussed with reference to a noon-location observer; for other positions, examine the ecliptic's obliquity and the moon's direction of travel, and the direction may be known.
translations.idiomatic: This assumes an observer on the local meridian; for other latitudes, determine direction from the ecliptic's tilt and the moon's course.

sentences.zh: 求月食所起：月在陰曆，初起東南，甚于正南，復於西南；

translations.literal: To find where the lunar eclipse begins: when the moon is in the lunar-path, first contact southeast, maximum due south, recovery southwest;
translations.idiomatic: To find lunar eclipse direction of first contact: with the moon in the lunar-path, first contact is southeast, maximum due south, and recovery southwest;

sentences.zh: 月在陽曆，初起東北，甚於正北，復於西北。

translations.literal: when the moon is in the solar-path, first contact northeast, maximum due north, recovery northwest.
translations.idiomatic: with the moon in the solar-path, first contact is northeast, maximum due north, and recovery northwest.

sentences.zh: 其食八分已上，皆起正東，復於正西。

translations.literal: When the eclipse is eight-tenths or more, all begin due east and recover due west.
translations.idiomatic: For eclipses of eight-tenths or greater, first contact is always due east and recovery due west.

sentences.zh: 此亦據午地而論之，其餘方位，依日食所向，即知既虧、復滿。

translations.literal: This too is discussed with reference to a noon-location observer; for other positions, follow the solar eclipse's directions, and one may know first diminishment and restoration fullness.
translations.idiomatic: This also assumes an observer on the local meridian; for other latitudes, follow the solar eclipse directions to determine first diminishment and restoration to full.
