sentences.zh: 推五星天正冬至後諸變中積中星：置氣積分，各以其星周率去之，不盡，覆減周率，余滿樞法除之為日，不滿，退除為分，即天正冬至後平合中積；

translations.literal: To compute the five planets' central accumulation and central star for all variations after civil new-year winter solstice: set the qi accumulated parts; for each cast out that star's circuit rate; what does not exhaust, subtract again from the circuit rate; when the remainder fills the pivot divisor divide for days, what does not fill, reduce back for parts — that is the mean-conjunction central accumulation after civil new-year winter solstice;
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's central accumulation and central star for all variations after civil new-year winter solstice: set the qi accumulated parts, cast out each star's circuit rate, subtract the remainder again from the circuit rate, divide by the pivot divisor for days with the remainder as parts, and obtain the mean-conjunction central accumulation after civil new-year winter solstice;

sentences.zh: 命之，積平合中星，以諸段變日、變度累加之，即諸變中積中星。

translations.literal: Name it and accumulate the mean-conjunction central star; cumulatively add each segment's variation days and variation degrees — that is the central accumulation and central star for all variations.
translations.idiomatic: Name the result and accumulate the mean-conjunction central star; add each segment's variation days and degrees cumulatively to obtain the central accumulation and central star for all variations.

sentences.zh: 其經退行者，即其變度；

translations.literal: For those that pass through retrograde motion, use its variation degree;
translations.idiomatic: For segments in retrograde motion, use the variation degree;

sentences.zh: 累減之，即其星其變中星。

translations.literal: cumulatively subtract — that is that star's variation central star.
translations.idiomatic: subtract cumulatively to obtain that star's variation central star.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸變入曆：以其星歲差乘積年，滿周天分去之，不盡，以樞法除之為度，不滿，退除為分，以減其星平合中星，即平合入曆；

translations.literal: To find the five planets' entry into the calendar cycle for all variations: multiply that star's precession by accumulated years; when full cast out circuit-of-heaven parts; what does not exhaust, divide by the pivot divisor for degrees, what does not fill, reduce back for parts; subtract from that star's mean-conjunction central star — that is mean-conjunction entry into the calendar cycle;
translations.idiomatic: To find entry into the calendar cycle for all five-planet variations: multiply that star's precession by accumulated years, cast out full circuit-of-heaven parts, convert the remainder to degrees and parts by the pivot divisor, subtract from that star's mean-conjunction central star, and obtain mean-conjunction entry into the calendar cycle;

sentences.zh: 以其星其變限度依次加之，各得其星諸變入曆度分。

translations.literal: Add that star's each variation limit degree in sequence — each obtains that star's entry-into-calendar degree and parts for all variations.
translations.idiomatic: Add that star's variation limit degrees in order to obtain entry-into-calendar degree and parts for every variation.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸變盈縮定差：各置其星其變入曆度分，半周天以下為在盈；

translations.literal: To find the five planets' excess-and-deficit fixed difference for all variations: for each set that star and variation's entry-into-calendar degree and parts; at half circuit-of-heaven and below is in excess;
translations.idiomatic: To find the excess-and-deficit fixed difference for all five-planet variations: set each star and variation's entry-into-calendar degree and parts; at or below half circuit-of-heaven counts as excess;

sentences.zh: 以上，減去半周天，餘為在縮。

translations.literal: if above, subtract half circuit-of-heaven; the remainder is in deficit.
translations.idiomatic: if above half circuit-of-heaven, subtract it; the remainder is in deficit.

sentences.zh: 置盈縮限度及分，以五星會策除之為會數，不盡，為入會度及分；

translations.literal: Set the excess-and-deficit limit degree and parts; divide by the five-planet conjunction stride for the conjunction count; what does not exhaust is the entry-into-conjunction degree and parts;
translations.idiomatic: Set the excess-and-deficit limit degree and parts, divide by the five-planet conjunction stride to obtain the conjunction count, and take the remainder as entry-into-conjunction degree and parts;

sentences.zh: 以其會下損益率乘之，會策除之為分，分滿百為度，以損益其下盈縮積度，即其星其變盈縮定差。

translations.literal: multiply the loss-and-gain rate below that conjunction, divide by the conjunction stride for parts; when parts fill one hundred they become degrees; apply it to the excess-and-deficit accumulated degree below — that is that star and variation's excess-and-deficit fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the tabulated loss-and-gain rate for that conjunction, divide by the conjunction stride for parts, convert parts filling 100 to degrees, apply to the underlying excess-and-deficit accumulated degree, and obtain that star and variation's excess-and-deficit fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 若用立成者，以其所入會度下差而用之。

translations.literal: If using precomputed tables, use the difference below the conjunction degree entered.
translations.idiomatic: If using precomputed tables, take the tabulated difference below the conjunction degree entered.

sentences.zh: 其木火土三星後退、後留者，置盈縮差，各列其星盈縮極度於下，皆以上減下，餘以乘上，八十七除之，所得，木、土三因，火直用之；

translations.literal: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn in posterior retreat and posterior station: set the excess-and-deficit difference; array each star's excess-and-deficit extreme degree below; in each case subtract below from above, multiply the remainder by above, divide by eighty-seven; for the result, triple for Jupiter and Saturn, use directly for Mars;
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn in posterior retreat and posterior station: set the excess-and-deficit difference, array each star's excess-and-deficit extreme degree below, subtract below from above, multiply the remainder by the upper value and divide by 87; triple the result for Jupiter and Saturn, and use it directly for Mars;

sentences.zh: 在盈益減損加、在縮益加損減其段盈縮差，為後退、後留定差，因為後遲初段定差。

translations.literal: when in excess, where benefit subtract and where deficit add; when in deficit, where benefit add and where deficit subtract — against its segment excess-and-deficit difference — that is the posterior retreat and posterior station fixed difference, thereby the posterior slow initial segment fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: When in excess, subtract where beneficial and add where deficient; when in deficit, add where beneficial and subtract where deficient — apply to the segment excess-and-deficit difference to obtain the posterior retreat and posterior station fixed difference, and thereby the posterior slow initial segment fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 各須類會前留定差，觀其盈縮初末，審察降殺，皆裒多益少而用之。

translations.literal: Each must be classified against the prior station fixed difference, observe the beginning and end of excess and deficit, examine the gradation, and in all cases apply by taking from the greater and giving to the lesser.
translations.idiomatic: Each case must be matched to the prior station fixed difference, observe excess and deficit at beginning and end, examine the gradation, and apply by taking from the greater and giving to the lesser.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸變定積：各置其星其變中積，以其變盈縮定差盈加縮減之，即其星其變定積及分；

translations.literal: To find the five planets' fixed accumulation for all variations: for each set that star and variation's central accumulation; add when in excess and subtract when in deficit by the variation's excess-and-deficit fixed difference — that is that star and variation's fixed accumulation and parts;
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed accumulation for all five-planet variations: set each star and variation's central accumulation, add or subtract the variation's excess-and-deficit fixed difference according to excess or deficit, and obtain that star and variation's fixed accumulation and parts;

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至大餘及分加之，即其星其變定日及分；

translations.literal: Add the civil new-year winter solstice greater remainder and parts — that is that star and variation's fixed day and parts;
translations.idiomatic: Add the civil new-year winter solstice greater remainder and parts to obtain that star and variation's fixed day and parts;

sentences.zh: 以紀法去定日，不盡，命甲子，算外，即得日辰。

translations.literal: When full cast out the era rule from the fixed day; what does not exhaust, name from jiazi outside the count — that yields the day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Cast out full era rules from the fixed day, name from jiazi outside the count, and obtain the day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸變在何月日：各置諸變定日，以其年天正經朔大餘及分減之，若冬至大餘少，加經朔大餘者，加紀法乃減之。

translations.literal: To find in which month and day the five planets' various variations fall: for each set the various variations' fixed days, subtract that year's civil new-year mean month-beginning major remainder and parts; if the winter solstice major remainder is less, having added the mean month-beginning major remainder, add the era method then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: To find which month and day each of the five planets' variations falls on: set each variation's fixed day and subtract the year's civil new-year mean month-beginning major remainder and parts; if the winter solstice major remainder is smaller and the mean month-beginning major remainder must be added first, add the era method before subtracting.

sentences.zh: 餘以朔策及分除之為月數，不滿，為入月日數及分。

translations.literal: With the remainder, divide by the new-moon stride and parts for month count; what does not fill is the days and parts into the month.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the remainder by the new-moon stride and parts to obtain the month count; the remainder gives the days and parts elapsed within the month.

sentences.zh: 其月數命以天正十一月，算外，即其星其變入其月經朔日數及分。

translations.literal: Name the month count from civil new year eleventh month, outside the count — that is that planet, that variation's days and parts into that month's mean month-beginning.
translations.idiomatic: Count months forward from the eleventh month at civil new year, outside the count, to obtain that planet's variation days and parts since that month's mean month-beginning.

sentences.zh: 若置定積，以天正閏月及分加之，朔策除為月數，亦得所求。

translations.literal: If one sets the fixed accumulation, adds the civil new-year intercalary month and parts, and divides by the new-moon stride for month count, one also obtains what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Alternatively, set the fixed accumulation, add the civil new-year intercalary month and parts, divide by the new-moon stride for the month count, and obtain the same result.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸變入何氣日：置定積，以氣策及約分除之為氣數，不盡，為入氣已來日數及分。

translations.literal: To find on which qi-period day the five planets' various variations enter: set the fixed accumulation, divide by the qi stride and approximate parts for qi count; what does not exhaust is the days and parts since entering qi.
translations.idiomatic: To find which qi-period day each planetary variation enters: set the fixed accumulation, divide by the qi stride and approximate parts for the qi count, and take the remainder as days and parts elapsed within the qi-period.

sentences.zh: 其氣數命起天正冬至，算外，即五星諸變入其氣日及分。

translations.literal: Name the qi count starting from civil new-year winter solstice, outside the count — that is the five planets' various variations entering that qi day and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Count qi-periods forward from the civil new-year winter solstice, outside the count, to obtain the qi day and parts at which the five planets' variations enter.

sentences.zh: 其定積滿歲周日及分即去之，餘在來年天正冬至後。

translations.literal: When the fixed accumulation fills the year-circuit day and parts, remove it; the remainder lies after the next year's civil new-year winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: When the fixed accumulation reaches a full year-circuit day and parts, cast it out; the remainder falls after the following year's civil new-year winter solstice.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸變定星：各置其變中星，以其變盈縮定差盈加縮減之，其金、水二星，金以倍之，水以三之，乃可加減。

translations.literal: To find the five planets' various variations' fixed star: for each set its variation mid-star, add for excess and subtract for deficit by its variation excess-deficit fixed difference; for Venus and Mercury, double for Venus and triple for Mercury before adding or subtracting.
translations.idiomatic: To find each planetary variation's fixed star: set the variation mid-star and adjust by its excess-deficit fixed difference, adding for excess and subtracting for deficit; for Venus and Mercury, double the difference for Venus and triple it for Mercury before applying the adjustment.

sentences.zh: 即五星諸變定星；

translations.literal: That is the five planets' various variations' fixed star;
translations.idiomatic: This yields the fixed star for each of the five planets' variations;

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至加時黃道日度加而命之，即其星其變加時定星宿次及分。

translations.literal: Add to and name from the civil new-year winter solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree — that is that planet, that variation's hour-of-addition fixed star lodge sequence and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the civil new-year winter solstice ecliptic solar degree at hour-of-addition and assign the lodge to obtain that planet's variation fixed star lodge sequence and parts at hour-of-addition.

sentences.zh: 五星皆以前留為前退初日定星，後留為後遲初日定星。

translations.literal: For all five planets, prior stationary is the prior retrograde first-day fixed star; subsequent stationary is the subsequent slow first-day fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: For all five planets, the prior stationary point serves as the first-day fixed star of prior retrograde motion, and the subsequent stationary point serves as the first-day fixed star of subsequent slow motion.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸變初日晨前夜半定星：以其星其變盈縮所入會度下盈縮積度與次度下盈縮積度相減，餘為其度損益分；

translations.literal: To find the five planets' various variations' first-day dawn-before-midnight fixed star: subtract the excess-deficit accumulated degrees under the next degree from those under the entered-conjunction degree of that planet's variation excess-deficit; the remainder is that degree's increment-decrement parts;
translations.idiomatic: To find each variation's first-day dawn-before-midnight fixed star: subtract the excess-deficit accumulated degrees at the next degree from those at the entered-conjunction degree of the planet's variation excess-deficit; the remainder is the degree's increment-decrement parts;

sentences.zh: 乘其變初行率，一百約之，所得，以加減其日初行率，在盈，益加損減；

translations.literal: Multiply by the variation's initial motion rate, hundred-reduce; apply the result to add or subtract from that day's initial motion rate — in excess, increment add and decrement subtract;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the variation's initial motion rate and hundred-reduce; use the result to adjust that day's initial motion rate — in the excess cycle, add for increment and subtract for decrement;

sentences.zh: 在縮，益減損加。

translations.literal: In deficit, increment subtract and decrement add.
translations.idiomatic: In the deficit cycle, subtract for increment and add for decrement.

sentences.zh: 為初行積率；

translations.literal: That is the initial motion accumulated rate;
translations.idiomatic: This gives the initial motion accumulated rate;

sentences.zh: 又置一百分，亦依其數加減之，以除初行積率，為初日定行率；

translations.literal: Also set one hundred parts, likewise add or subtract by that number, divide the initial motion accumulated rate — that is the first-day fixed motion rate;
translations.idiomatic: Also set one hundred parts, adjust it by the same amount, divide the initial motion accumulated rate by the result, and obtain the first-day fixed motion rate;

sentences.zh: 以乘其率初日約分，一百約之，順減退加其日加時定星，為其變晨前夜半定星；

translations.literal: Multiply by that rate's first-day approximate parts, hundred-reduce; for direct motion subtract and for retrograde motion add to that day's hour-of-addition fixed star — that is the variation's dawn-before-midnight fixed star;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by that rate's first-day approximate parts and hundred-reduce; subtract in direct motion and add in retrograde motion to that day's hour-of-addition fixed star to obtain the variation's dawn-before-midnight fixed star;

sentences.zh: 加冬至時日度命之，即所在宿次。

translations.literal: Add to the winter solstice time solar degree and name — that is the lodge sequence where it stands.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the winter solstice solar degree at that time and assign the lodge to obtain its lodge position.

sentences.zh: 求諸變日度率：置後變定日，以其變定日減之，餘為其變日率；

translations.literal: To find the various variations' day and degree rates: set the subsequent variation's fixed day, subtract this variation's fixed day — the remainder is that variation's day rate;
translations.idiomatic: To find each variation's day and degree rates: set the subsequent variation's fixed day and subtract this variation's fixed day; the remainder is that variation's day rate;

sentences.zh: 又置後變夜半定星，以其變夜半定星及分減之，餘為其變度率及分。

translations.literal: Also set the subsequent variation's midnight fixed star, subtract this variation's midnight fixed star and parts — the remainder is that variation's degree rate and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Also set the subsequent variation's midnight fixed star and subtract this variation's midnight fixed star and parts; the remainder is that variation's degree rate and parts.

sentences.zh: 求諸變平行分：各置其變度率及分，以其變日率除之為平行分，不滿，退除為秒，即各得平行度及分秒。

translations.literal: To find the various variations' parallel motion: for each set its variation degree rate and parts, divide by its variation day rate for parallel motion; what does not fill, retreat-divide for seconds — each then obtains parallel degrees and parts-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find each variation's parallel motion: set its degree rate and parts, divide by its day rate to obtain parallel motion; convert any remainder by retreat-division into seconds, yielding parallel degrees and parts-seconds for each.

sentences.zh: 求諸變總差：各以其段平行分與後段平行分相減，餘為泛差；

translations.literal: To find the various variations' total difference: for each subtract this segment's parallel motion from the subsequent segment's parallel motion — the remainder is the generalized difference;
translations.idiomatic: To find each variation's total difference: subtract this segment's parallel motion from the subsequent segment's parallel motion; the remainder is the generalized difference;

sentences.zh: 並前段泛差，四因之，九而一，為總差。

translations.literal: Add the prior segment's generalized difference, multiply by four, divide by nine — that is the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: Add the prior segment's generalized difference, multiply by four, divide by nine, and obtain the total difference.

sentences.zh: 若前段無平行分相減為泛差者，各因後段初日行分與其段平行分相減，為半總差；

translations.literal: If the prior segment has no parallel motion from which to subtract for a generalized difference, for each multiply the subsequent segment's first-day motion parts minus this segment's parallel motion — that is the half total difference;
translations.idiomatic: If the prior segment lacks a parallel motion for subtraction, subtract this segment's parallel motion from the subsequent segment's first-day motion parts for each case; the result is the half total difference;

sentences.zh: 倍之，為總差。

translations.literal: Double it — that is the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: Double the result to obtain the total difference.

sentences.zh: 若後段無平行分相減為泛差者，各因前段末日行分與其段平行分相減，為半總差。

translations.literal: If the subsequent segment has no parallel motion from which to subtract for a generalized difference, for each multiply this segment's last-day motion parts minus this segment's parallel motion — that is the half total difference.
translations.idiomatic: If the subsequent segment lacks a parallel motion for subtraction, subtract this segment's parallel motion from its last-day motion parts for each case; the result is the half total difference.

sentences.zh: 其前後退行者，各置本段平行分，十四乘，十五除，為總差。

translations.literal: For those in prior and subsequent retrograde motion, for each set this segment's parallel motion, multiply by fourteen, divide by fifteen — that is the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: For segments in prior and subsequent retrograde motion, set each segment's parallel motion, multiply by fourteen, divide by fifteen, and obtain the total difference.

sentences.zh: 其金星夕退、夕伏、再合、晨退，各依順段術入之，即得所求。

translations.literal: For Venus evening retrograde, evening concealment, second conjunction, and morning retrograde, in each case follow the direct-segment procedure to obtain what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus in evening retrograde, evening concealment, second conjunction, and morning retrograde, apply the direct-segment method in each case to obtain the desired values.

sentences.zh: 求諸段初末日行分：各半其段總差，加減其段平行分，後段行分多者，減之為初，加之為末；

translations.literal: To find each segment's first and last day motion parts: for each halve that segment's total difference and add or subtract to that segment's parallel motion — if the subsequent segment's motion parts are greater, subtract for the first and add for the last;
translations.idiomatic: To find each segment's first- and last-day motion parts: halve the segment's total difference and add or subtract it from the segment's parallel motion — if the subsequent segment's motion parts are greater, subtract for the first day and add for the last;

sentences.zh: 後段行分少者，加之為初，減之為末。

translations.literal: If the subsequent segment's motion parts are lesser, add for the first and subtract for the last.
translations.idiomatic: If the subsequent segment's motion parts are lesser, add for the first day and subtract for the last.

sentences.zh: 即各得其星其段初、末日行度及分秒。

translations.literal: Each then obtains that planet, that segment's first and last day motion degrees and parts-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Each planet's segment then yields first- and last-day motion in degrees and parts-seconds.

sentences.zh: 凡前後段平行分俱多或俱少，乃平注之；

translations.literal: Whenever the prior and subsequent segments' parallel motion are both greater or both lesser, then evenly distribute the correction;
translations.idiomatic: When consecutive segments' parallel motion is both greater or both lesser, distribute the correction evenly;

sentences.zh: 及本段總差不滿大分者，亦平注之。

translations.literal: Also when this segment's total difference does not fill a major part, evenly distribute the correction likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Likewise, when a segment's total difference is less than one major part, distribute the correction evenly.

sentences.zh: 其退行段，各以半總差前變減之為初，加之為末；

translations.literal: For retrograde segments, for each subtract half the total difference before the variation for the first and add for the last;
translations.idiomatic: For retrograde segments, subtract half the total difference before the variation for the first day and add it for the last;

sentences.zh: 後變加之為初，減之為末。

translations.literal: For the subsequent variation, add for the first and subtract for the last.
translations.idiomatic: For the subsequent variation, add for the first day and subtract for the last.

sentences.zh: 求每日晨前夜半星行宿次：置其段總差，減其段日率，以除之，為日差；

translations.literal: To find each day's dawn-before-midnight star motion lodge sequence: set the segment's total difference, subtract the segment's day rate, divide — that is the day difference;
translations.idiomatic: To find each day's dawn-before-midnight star lodge position: set the segment's total difference, subtract the segment's day rate, and divide to obtain the day difference;

sentences.zh: 以日差累損益初日行分，後段行分少，日損之；

translations.literal: With the day difference cumulatively increment or decrement the first-day motion parts — if the subsequent segment's motion parts are lesser, decrement daily;
translations.idiomatic: Apply the day difference cumulatively to the first-day motion parts — if the subsequent segment's motion parts are lesser, decrement daily;

sentences.zh: 後段行分多，日益之。

translations.literal: If the subsequent segment's motion parts are greater, increment daily.
translations.idiomatic: If the subsequent segment's motion parts are greater, increment daily.

sentences.zh: 為每日行度及分；

translations.literal: That is each day's motion degrees and parts;
translations.idiomatic: This yields each day's motion in degrees and parts;

sentences.zh: 以每日行度及分累加其星其段初日晨前夜半宿次，命之，即每日星行宿次。

translations.literal: Cumulatively add each day's motion degrees and parts to that planet, that segment's first-day dawn-before-midnight lodge sequence and name — that is each day's star motion lodge sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Cumulatively add each day's motion degrees and parts to the planet's segment first-day dawn-before-midnight lodge position and assign lodges to obtain each day's star motion lodge sequence.

sentences.zh: 遇退行者，以每日行分累減之，即得所求。

translations.literal: Where retrograde motion occurs, cumulatively subtract with each day's motion parts — then obtain what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: In retrograde motion, cumulatively subtract each day's motion parts to obtain the desired lodge sequence.

sentences.zh: 徑求其日宿次：置所求日，減一，日差乘之，加減初日行分，後行分少，即減之；

translations.literal: Directly find that day's lodge sequence: set the sought day, subtract one, multiply by the day difference, add or subtract from the first-day motion parts — if the subsequent motion parts are lesser, subtract;
translations.idiomatic: To find a given day's lodge position directly: set the sought day, subtract one, multiply by the day difference, and adjust the first-day motion parts — subtract if the subsequent motion parts are lesser;

sentences.zh: 後行分多，即加之。

translations.literal: If the subsequent motion parts are greater, add.
translations.idiomatic: Add if the subsequent motion parts are greater.

sentences.zh: 為所求日行分；

translations.literal: That is the sought day's motion parts;
translations.idiomatic: This gives the sought day's motion parts;

sentences.zh: 加日行分而半之；

translations.literal: Add the daily motion parts and halve;
translations.idiomatic: Add the daily motion parts and halve the sum;

sentences.zh: 以所求日乘之，為徑求積度；

translations.literal: Multiply by the sought day — that is the direct-seek accumulated degree;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the sought day to obtain the direct-seek accumulated degree;

sentences.zh: 加減其星初日宿次；

translations.literal: Add or subtract to that star's first-day lodge sequence;
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract this from the star's first-day lodge position;

sentences.zh: 命之，即其日星行宿次。

translations.literal: Name — that is that day's star motion lodge sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Assign the lodge to obtain that day's star motion lodge sequence.

sentences.zh: 求五星定合日定星：以其星平合初日行分減一百分，餘以約其日太陽盈縮分為分，分滿百為日，不滿為分，命為距合差日；

translations.literal: To find the five planets' fixed conjunction day and fixed star: subtract one hundred parts from that star's mean-conjunction first-day motion parts; with the remainder reduce that day's solar excess-deficit parts for parts; when parts fill one hundred that makes days, what does not fill is parts — name as distance-from-conjunction difference day;
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's fixed conjunction day and fixed star: subtract one hundred parts from the mean-conjunction first-day motion parts; use the remainder to reduce that day's solar excess-deficit into parts, converting hundreds of parts to days with the remainder as parts, and name the result the distance-from-conjunction difference day;

sentences.zh: 以盈縮分減之，為距合差度；

translations.literal: Subtract the excess-deficit parts — that is the distance-from-conjunction difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the excess-deficit parts to obtain the distance-from-conjunction difference degree;

sentences.zh: 以差日、差度縮加盈減平合定積、定星，為其星定合日定積、定星。

translations.literal: With the difference day and difference degree, when in deficit add and when in excess subtract to the mean-conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star — that is that star's fixed-conjunction fixed day, fixed accumulation, and fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the difference day and difference degree to the mean-conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star, adding when in deficit and subtracting when in excess, to obtain that star's fixed-conjunction day, fixed accumulation, and fixed star.

sentences.zh: 其金、水二星，以一百分減初日行分，餘以除其日太陽盈縮分，為距合差日；

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury, subtract one hundred parts from the first-day motion parts; with the remainder divide that day's solar excess-deficit parts — that is the distance-from-conjunction difference day;
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury, subtract one hundred parts from the first-day motion parts, divide that day's solar excess-deficit parts by the remainder, and obtain the distance-from-conjunction difference day;

sentences.zh: 以盈縮分加之，為距合差度；

translations.literal: Add the excess-deficit parts — that is the distance-from-conjunction difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: Add the excess-deficit parts to obtain the distance-from-conjunction difference degree;

sentences.zh: 以差日、差度盈加縮減之。

translations.literal: Apply the difference day and difference degree: add when in excess and subtract when in deficit.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the difference day and difference degree, adding when in excess and subtracting when in deficit.

sentences.zh: 金、水二星退合者，以初日行分加一百分，以除太陽盈縮分，為距合差日；

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury in retrograde conjunction, add one hundred parts to the first-day motion parts and divide the solar excess-deficit parts — that is the distance-from-conjunction difference day;
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury in retrograde conjunction, add one hundred parts to the first-day motion parts, divide the solar excess-deficit parts by the sum, and obtain the distance-from-conjunction difference day;

sentences.zh: 以距合差日減盈縮分，為距合差度；

translations.literal: Subtract the excess-deficit parts by the distance-from-conjunction difference day — that is the distance-from-conjunction difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the distance-from-conjunction difference day from the excess-deficit parts to obtain the distance-from-conjunction difference degree;

sentences.zh: 以差日、差度盈減縮加再合定積定星為其星再合定日定積定星。

translations.literal: With the difference day and difference degree, when in excess subtract and when in deficit add to the second-conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star — that is that star's second-conjunction fixed day, fixed accumulation, and fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the difference day and difference degree to the second-conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star, subtracting when in excess and adding when in deficit, to obtain that star's second-conjunction fixed day, fixed accumulation, and fixed star.

sentences.zh: 其金、水二星定積，各依見伏術，先以盈縮差求其加減訖，然後以距合差日、差度加減之。

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury fixed accumulations, each according to the visibility-and-concealment procedure, first complete the add-or-subtract by excess-deficit difference, then add or subtract by the distance-from-conjunction difference day and difference degree.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury fixed accumulations, follow the visibility-and-concealment procedure in each case: first apply the excess-deficit difference, then adjust by the distance-from-conjunction difference day and difference degree.

sentences.zh: 求木火土三星晨見夕伏定日：各置其星其段定積，乃加減一象度，晨見加之，夕伏減之。

translations.literal: To find Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn morning appearance and evening concealment fixed day: for each set that star, that segment's fixed accumulation, then add or subtract one-quadrant degree — add for morning appearance and subtract for evening concealment.
translations.idiomatic: To find Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn morning appearance and evening concealment fixed days: set each star's segment fixed accumulation, then add or subtract one-quadrant degree — add for morning appearance and subtract for evening concealment.

sentences.zh: 半周天已下自相乘，半周天已上，覆減周天度及分，餘亦自相乘，一百約為分，以其星伏見度乘之，十五除之，為差；

translations.literal: At or below half circuit-of-heaven, self-multiply; above half circuit-of-heaven, overturn-subtract from circuit-of-heaven degrees and parts, self-multiply the remainder too, hundred-reduce for parts, multiply by that star's heliacal visibility degree, divide by fifteen — that is the difference;
translations.idiomatic: If at or below half circuit-of-heaven, square the value; if above, subtract from circuit-of-heaven degrees and parts and square the remainder; hundred-reduce to parts, multiply by that star's heliacal visibility degree, divide by fifteen, and obtain the difference;

sentences.zh: 乃以其段初日行分覆減一百分，餘以除其差為日，不滿，退除為分，所得，以加減定積，晨見加之，夕伏減之。

translations.literal: Then with that segment's first-day motion parts overturn-subtract one hundred parts; with the remainder divide the difference for days, what does not fill, reduce back for parts; the result is used to add or subtract the fixed accumulation — add for morning appearance and subtract for evening concealment.
translations.idiomatic: Then subtract one hundred parts from that segment's first-day motion parts, divide the difference by the remainder for days with the remainder as parts, and add or subtract the result from the fixed accumulation — add for morning appearance and subtract for evening concealment.

sentences.zh: 各得晨見、夕伏定積；

translations.literal: Each then obtains morning appearance and evening concealment fixed accumulation;
translations.idiomatic: Each then yields morning appearance and evening concealment fixed accumulation;

sentences.zh: 加天正冬至大餘及分，命甲子，算外，即得日辰。

translations.literal: Add civil new-year winter solstice major remainder and parts, name from jiazi, outside the count — that obtains the day and time.
translations.idiomatic: Add the civil new-year winter solstice major remainder and parts, count from jiazi, outside the count, and obtain the day and time.

sentences.zh: 求金水二星夕見晨伏定日：各置其星其段定積，其定積先倍其段盈縮差，縮加盈減之，乃加減一象度，夕見減之，晨伏加之。

translations.literal: To find Venus and Mercury evening appearance and morning concealment fixed day: for each set that star, that segment's fixed accumulation; first double that segment's excess-deficit difference to the fixed accumulation, add when in deficit and subtract when in excess, then add or subtract one-quadrant degree — subtract for evening appearance and add for morning concealment.
translations.idiomatic: To find Venus and Mercury evening appearance and morning concealment fixed days: set each star's segment fixed accumulation, double the segment's excess-deficit difference and apply it to the fixed accumulation (add when in deficit, subtract when in excess), then add or subtract one-quadrant degree — subtract for evening appearance and add for morning concealment.

sentences.zh: 半周天已下自相乘，已上，覆減周天度，餘亦自相乘，一百約為分，以其星伏見度乘之，十五除為差；

translations.literal: At or below half circuit-of-heaven, self-multiply; above, overturn-subtract circuit-of-heaven degrees, self-multiply the remainder, hundred-reduce for parts, multiply by that star's heliacal visibility degree, divide by fifteen for the difference;
translations.idiomatic: If at or below half circuit-of-heaven, square the value; if above, subtract from circuit-of-heaven degrees and square the remainder; hundred-reduce to parts, multiply by that star's heliacal visibility degree, divide by fifteen, and obtain the difference;

sentences.zh: 乃置其段初日行分，減去一百分，餘以除其差為日，不滿，退除為分，所得，以加減定積，夕見加之，晨伏減之。

translations.literal: Then set that segment's first-day motion parts, subtract one hundred parts, with the remainder divide the difference for days, what does not fill, reduce back for parts; the result is used to add or subtract the fixed accumulation — add for evening appearance and subtract for morning concealment.
translations.idiomatic: Then subtract one hundred parts from that segment's first-day motion parts, divide the difference by the remainder for days with the remainder as parts, and add or subtract the result from the fixed accumulation — add for evening appearance and subtract for morning concealment.

sentences.zh: 各得夕見、晨伏定積。

translations.literal: Each then obtains evening appearance and morning concealment fixed accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Each then yields evening appearance and morning concealment fixed accumulation.

sentences.zh: 求金水二星晨見夕伏定日：置其星其段定積，其定積先以一百乘其段盈縮差，乃以一百分加其日行分，以除其差，所得，盈加縮減之，加減一象度，晨見加之，夕伏減之。

translations.literal: To find Venus and Mercury morning appearance and evening concealment fixed day: set that star, that segment's fixed accumulation; first multiply that segment's excess-deficit difference by one hundred to the fixed accumulation, then add one hundred parts to its daily motion parts and divide the difference; the result is applied excess-add and deficit-subtract; add or subtract one-quadrant degree — add for morning appearance and subtract for evening concealment.
translations.idiomatic: To find Venus and Mercury morning appearance and evening concealment fixed days: set the star's segment fixed accumulation, multiply the segment's excess-deficit difference by one hundred and apply it to the fixed accumulation, add one hundred parts to the daily motion parts and divide the difference, apply the result (add when in excess, subtract when in deficit), then add or subtract one-quadrant degree — add for morning appearance and subtract for evening concealment.

sentences.zh: 半周天已下自相乘，已上，覆減周天度，餘亦自相乘，一百約為分，以其星伏見度乘之，十五除，為差；

translations.literal: At or below half circuit-of-heaven, self-multiply; above, overturn-subtract circuit-of-heaven degrees, self-multiply the remainder, hundred-reduce for parts, multiply by that star's heliacal visibility degree, divide by fifteen — that is the difference;
translations.idiomatic: If at or below half circuit-of-heaven, square the value; if above, subtract from circuit-of-heaven degrees and square the remainder; hundred-reduce to parts, multiply by that star's heliacal visibility degree, divide by fifteen, and obtain the difference;

sentences.zh: 乃置其段初日行分，如一百，以除其差為日，不滿，退除為分，所得，以加減定積，晨見加之，夕伏減之。

translations.literal: Then set that segment's first-day motion parts equal to one hundred, divide the difference for days, what does not fill, reduce back for parts; the result is used to add or subtract the fixed accumulation — add for morning appearance and subtract for evening concealment.
translations.idiomatic: Then set that segment's first-day motion parts to one hundred, divide the difference for days with the remainder as parts, and add or subtract the result from the fixed accumulation — add for morning appearance and subtract for evening concealment.

sentences.zh: 各為其星晨見、夕伏定積。

translations.literal: Each becomes that star's morning appearance and evening concealment fixed accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Each yields that star's morning appearance and evening concealment fixed accumulation.

sentences.zh: 曆既成，以來年甲子歲用之，是年五月丁亥朔，日食不效，算食二分半，候之不食。

translations.literal: When the calendar was complete, it was put in use for the following jiazi year; in that year's fifth month, dinghai new moon, the solar eclipse did not occur as predicted — the calculation showed an eclipse of two and a half parts, but observation showed no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: When the calendar was finished it was adopted for the following jiazi year; on the dinghai new moon of the fifth month that year the predicted solar eclipse failed — the calculation showed an eclipse of two and a half parts, but observation found none.

sentences.zh: 詔候驗。

translations.literal: An edict ordered observation and verification.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered observational verification.

sentences.zh: 至七年，命入內都知江德明集曆官用渾儀較測。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Jiang Deming, Director of the Inner Palace, was ordered to gather calendar officials and compare measurements with the armillary sphere.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Jiang Deming, Director of the Inner Palace, was ordered to assemble calendar officials and compare measurements with the armillary sphere.

sentences.zh: 時周琮言：「古之造曆，必使千百年間星度交食，若應繩准，今曆成而不驗，則曆法為未密。

translations.literal: At the time Zhou Cong said: "In antiquity calendar-makers ensured that over a thousand years star positions and eclipses would align like a plumb line; now the calendar is complete yet fails verification — the calendar method is not yet precise."
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhou Cong said: "Ancient calendar-makers made star positions and eclipses over a thousand years align like a plumb line; now the calendar is finished yet fails verification, so the calendar method is not yet precise."

sentences.zh: 」又有楊皞、於淵者，與琮求較驗，而皞術於木為得，淵于金為得，琮於月、土為得，詔增入《崇天曆》，其改用率數如後：

translations.literal: There were also Yang Hao and Yu Yuan, who with Cong sought comparative verification; Hao's method proved correct for Jupiter, Yuan's for Venus, and Cong's for the Moon and Saturn. An edict ordered these added to the Chongtian Calendar. The revised constants are as follows:
translations.idiomatic: Yang Hao and Yu Yuan also joined Cong in seeking comparative verification; Hao's method proved correct for Jupiter, Yuan's for Venus, and Cong's for the Moon and Saturn. An edict ordered these incorporated into the Chongtian Calendar. The revised rate constants are as follows:

sentences.zh: 周天分：三百八十六萬八千六十六、秒一十七。

translations.literal: Circuit-of-heaven parts: 3,868,066, 17 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit-of-heaven parts: 3,868,066, 17 seconds.

sentences.zh: 周天：三百六十五度。

translations.literal: Circuit-of-heaven: 365 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit-of-heaven: 365 degrees.

sentences.zh: 虛分二千七百一十六、秒十七，約分二十五、秒六十一。

translations.literal: Void fraction: 2,716, 17 seconds; approximate fraction: 25, 61 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Void fraction: 2,716, 17 seconds; approximate fraction: 25, 61 seconds.

sentences.zh: 歲差：一百二十六、秒一十七。

translations.literal: Precession: 126, 17 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Precession: 126, 17 seconds.

sentences.zh: 求諸變總差：各以其段平行分與後段平行分相減，餘為泛差；

translations.literal: To find the various variations' total difference: for each subtract this segment's parallel motion from the subsequent segment's parallel motion — the remainder is the generalized difference;
translations.idiomatic: To find each variation's total difference: subtract this segment's parallel motion from the subsequent segment's parallel motion; the remainder is the generalized difference;

sentences.zh: 並前段泛差，四因之，退一等，為總差。

translations.literal: Add the prior segment's generalized difference, multiply by four, retreat one place — that is the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: Add the prior segment's generalized difference, multiply by four, retreat one place, and obtain the total difference.

sentences.zh: 若前段無平行分相減為泛差，各因後段初日行分與其段平行分相減，為半總差；

translations.literal: If the prior segment has no parallel motion from which to subtract for a generalized difference, for each subtract this segment's parallel motion from the subsequent segment's first-day motion parts — that is the half total difference;
translations.idiomatic: If the prior segment lacks a parallel motion for subtraction, subtract this segment's parallel motion from the subsequent segment's first-day motion parts for each case; the result is the half total difference;

sentences.zh: 倍之，為總差。

translations.literal: Double it — that is the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: Double the result to obtain the total difference.

sentences.zh: 若後段無平行分相減為泛差者，各因前段末日行分與其段平行分相減，為半總差；

translations.literal: If the subsequent segment has no parallel motion from which to subtract for a generalized difference, for each subtract this segment's parallel motion from its last-day motion parts — that is the half total difference;
translations.idiomatic: If the subsequent segment lacks a parallel motion for subtraction, subtract this segment's parallel motion from its last-day motion parts for each case; the result is the half total difference;

sentences.zh: 倍之，為總差。

translations.literal: Double it — that is the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: Double the result to obtain the total difference.

sentences.zh: 其前後退行者，各置本段平行分，十四乘，十五除，為總差。

translations.literal: For those in prior and subsequent retrograde motion, for each set this segment's parallel motion, multiply by fourteen, divide by fifteen — that is the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: For segments in prior and subsequent retrograde motion, set each segment's parallel motion, multiply by fourteen, divide by fifteen, and obtain the total difference.

sentences.zh: 其金星夕退、夕伏、再合、晨退，各依順段術入之，即得所求。

translations.literal: For Venus evening retrograde, evening concealment, second conjunction, and morning retrograde, in each case follow the direct-segment procedure to obtain what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus in evening retrograde, evening concealment, second conjunction, and morning retrograde, apply the direct-segment method in each case to obtain the desired values.

sentences.zh: 求五星定合及見伏泛用積：其木、火、土三星，各以平合及前疾、後伏定積為泛用積，金、水二星平合及夕見、晨伏者，置其星其段盈縮差，金以倍之，水以三之，列於上位；

translations.literal: To find the five planets' fixed conjunction and visibility-and-concealment general-use accumulation: for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, each take the mean-conjunction and prior-swift and posterior-concealment fixed accumulations as the general-use accumulation; for Venus and Mercury at mean-conjunction and evening appearance and morning concealment, set that star, that segment's excess-deficit difference — double for Venus and triple for Mercury — and array above;
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's fixed conjunction and visibility-and-concealment general-use accumulation: for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, use the mean-conjunction and prior-swift and posterior-concealment fixed accumulations as the general-use accumulation; for Venus and Mercury at mean-conjunction, evening appearance, and morning concealment, set the segment's excess-deficit difference (double for Venus, triple for Mercury) in the upper row;

sentences.zh: 又置盈縮差，以其段初行率乘之，退二等，以減上位；

translations.literal: Again set the excess-deficit difference, multiply by that segment's first-motion rate, retreat two places, and subtract from the upper row;
translations.idiomatic: Set the excess-deficit difference again, multiply by that segment's first-motion rate, retreat two places, and subtract from the upper row;

sentences.zh: 又置初行率，減去一百分，餘以除之為日，不滿，退除為分，乃盈減縮加中積，為其星其變泛用積。

translations.literal: Again set the first-motion rate, subtract one hundred parts, with the remainder divide for days, what does not fill, reduce back for parts; then when in excess subtract and when in deficit add to the middle accumulation — that is that star, that variation's general-use accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Set the first-motion rate, subtract one hundred parts, divide by the remainder for days with the remainder as parts, then subtract when in excess and add when in deficit to the middle accumulation, and obtain that star and variation's general-use accumulation.

sentences.zh: 金、水二星再合及夕伏、晨見者，其星其段盈縮差，金星直用，水以倍之，進二位，以其段初行率加一百分以除之，所得，並盈縮差，以盈加縮減中積，為其星其段泛用積。

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury at second conjunction and evening concealment and morning appearance, set that star, that segment's excess-deficit difference — use directly for Venus and double for Mercury — advance two places; add one hundred parts to that segment's first-motion rate and divide; combine with the excess-deficit difference; when in excess add and when in deficit subtract to the middle accumulation — that is that star, that segment's general-use accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury at second conjunction, evening concealment, and morning appearance, set the segment's excess-deficit difference (use directly for Venus, double for Mercury), advance two places, add one hundred parts to the first-motion rate and divide, combine with the excess-deficit difference, add or subtract to the middle accumulation according to excess or deficit, and obtain that star and segment's general-use accumulation.

sentences.zh: 求五星定合定積定星：其木、火、土三星平合者，以平合初日行分減一百分，餘以約其日太陽盈縮分為分，滿百為日，不滿為分，命為距合差日；

translations.literal: To find the five planets' fixed-conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star: for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn at mean-conjunction, subtract one hundred parts from the mean-conjunction first-day motion parts; with the remainder reduce that day's solar excess-deficit parts for parts; when parts fill one hundred that makes days, what does not fill is parts — name as the distance-from-conjunction difference day;
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's fixed-conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star: for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn at mean-conjunction, subtract one hundred parts from the mean-conjunction first-day motion parts, use the remainder to reduce that day's solar excess-deficit into parts, convert hundreds of parts to days with the remainder as parts, and name the result the distance-from-conjunction difference day;

sentences.zh: 以盈縮分減之，為距合差度；

translations.literal: Subtract the excess-deficit parts — that is the distance-from-conjunction difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the excess-deficit parts to obtain the distance-from-conjunction difference degree;

sentences.zh: 以差日、差度縮加盈減其星平合泛用積，為其星定合日定積定星。

translations.literal: With the difference day and difference degree, when in deficit add and when in excess subtract to that star's mean-conjunction general-use accumulation — that is that star's fixed-conjunction fixed day, fixed accumulation, and fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the difference day and difference degree to the mean-conjunction general-use accumulation, adding when in deficit and subtracting when in excess, to obtain that star's fixed-conjunction day, fixed accumulation, and fixed star.

sentences.zh: 金、水二星平合者，以一百分減初日行分，餘以除其日太陽盈縮分，為距合差日；

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury at mean-conjunction, subtract one hundred parts from the first-day motion parts; with the remainder divide that day's solar excess-deficit parts — that is the distance-from-conjunction difference day;
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury at mean-conjunction, subtract one hundred parts from the first-day motion parts, divide that day's solar excess-deficit parts by the remainder, and obtain the distance-from-conjunction difference day;

sentences.zh: 以盈縮分加之，為距合差度；

translations.literal: Add the excess-deficit parts — that is the distance-from-conjunction difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: Add the excess-deficit parts to obtain the distance-from-conjunction difference degree;

sentences.zh: 以差日、差度盈加縮減平合泛用積，為其星定合日定積定星也。

translations.literal: With the difference day and difference degree, when in excess add and when in deficit subtract to the mean-conjunction general-use accumulation — that is that star's fixed-conjunction fixed day, fixed accumulation, and fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the difference day and difference degree to the mean-conjunction general-use accumulation, adding when in excess and subtracting when in deficit, to obtain that star's fixed-conjunction day, fixed accumulation, and fixed star.

sentences.zh: 金、水二星退合者，以初日行分一百分，以除太陽盈縮分，為距合差日；

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury in retrograde conjunction, add one hundred parts to the first-day motion parts and divide the solar excess-deficit parts — that is the distance-from-conjunction difference day;
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury in retrograde conjunction, add one hundred parts to the first-day motion parts, divide the solar excess-deficit parts by the sum, and obtain the distance-from-conjunction difference day;

sentences.zh: 以距合差日減盈縮分，為距合差度；

translations.literal: Subtract the excess-deficit parts by the distance-from-conjunction difference day — that is the distance-from-conjunction difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the distance-from-conjunction difference day from the excess-deficit parts to obtain the distance-from-conjunction difference degree;

sentences.zh: 以差日盈減縮加再合泛用積，為其星再合定日定積差度；

translations.literal: With the difference day, when in excess subtract and when in deficit add to the second-conjunction general-use accumulation — that is that star's second-conjunction fixed day, fixed accumulation, and difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: Apply the difference day to the second-conjunction general-use accumulation, subtracting when in excess and adding when in deficit, to obtain that star's second-conjunction fixed day, fixed accumulation, and difference degree;

sentences.zh: 盈加縮減再合泛用積，為其星再合日定星；

translations.literal: When in excess add and when in deficit subtract to the second-conjunction general-use accumulation — that is that star's second-conjunction fixed day and fixed star;
translations.idiomatic: Add when in excess and subtract when in deficit to the second-conjunction general-use accumulation to obtain that star's second-conjunction fixed day and fixed star;

sentences.zh: 各加冬至大、小余及黃道加時日躔宿次命之，即得其日日辰及宿次。

translations.literal: For each add winter solstice major and minor remainders and name from the ecliptic hour-of-addition solar daily-motion lodge sequence — that obtains that day's day and time and lodge sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Add the winter solstice major and minor remainders for each case and assign lodges from the ecliptic hour-of-addition solar position to obtain that day's date, time, and lodge sequence.

sentences.zh: 求木火土星晨見夕伏定用積：各置其星其段泛用積，乃加減一象度，晨見加之，夕伏減之。

translations.literal: To find Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn morning appearance and evening concealment fixed-use accumulation: for each set that star, that segment's general-use accumulation, then add or subtract one-quadrant degree — add for morning appearance and subtract for evening concealment.
translations.idiomatic: To find Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn morning appearance and evening concealment fixed-use accumulation: set each star's segment general-use accumulation, then add or subtract one-quadrant degree — add for morning appearance and subtract for evening concealment.

sentences.zh: 半周天已下自相乘，已上，覆減周天度，餘亦自相乘，各二因百約之，在一百六十七已上，以一百約其日太陽盈縮分減之，不滿一百六十七者即加之，以其星本伏見度乘之，十五除，為差；

translations.literal: At or below half circuit-of-heaven, self-multiply; above, overturn-subtract circuit-of-heaven degrees, self-multiply the remainder; each double and hundred-reduce; if at or above 167, subtract one hundred of that day's solar excess-deficit parts; if below 167, add instead; multiply by that star's base heliacal visibility degree, divide by fifteen — that is the difference;
translations.idiomatic: If at or below half circuit-of-heaven, square the value; if above, subtract from circuit-of-heaven degrees and square the remainder; double and hundred-reduce each; if at or above 167 subtract one hundred of that day's solar excess-deficit parts, otherwise add; multiply by that star's base heliacal visibility degree, divide by fifteen, and obtain the difference;

sentences.zh: 乃置其段初日行分，覆減一百分，餘以除其差為日，不滿，退除為分所得，以加減泛用積，晨見加之，夕伏減之。

translations.literal: Then set that segment's first-day motion parts, overturn-subtract one hundred parts, with the remainder divide the difference for days, what does not fill, reduce back for parts; the result is used to add or subtract the general-use accumulation — add for morning appearance and subtract for evening concealment.
translations.idiomatic: Then subtract one hundred parts from that segment's first-day motion parts, divide the difference by the remainder for days with the remainder as parts, and add or subtract the result from the general-use accumulation — add for morning appearance and subtract for evening concealment.

sentences.zh: 各得其星晨見、夕伏定用積；

translations.literal: Each then obtains that star's morning appearance and evening concealment fixed-use accumulation;
translations.idiomatic: Each then yields that star's morning appearance and evening concealment fixed-use accumulation;

sentences.zh: 加天正冬至大餘，命甲子，算外，即得日辰。

translations.literal: Add civil new-year winter solstice major remainder, name from jiazi, outside the count — that obtains the day and time.
translations.idiomatic: Add the civil new-year winter solstice major remainder, count from jiazi, outside the count, and obtain the day and time.

sentences.zh: 求金水二星夕見晨伏定用積：各置其星其段泛用積，乃加減一象度，夕見減之，晨伏加之。

translations.literal: To find Venus and Mercury evening appearance and morning concealment fixed-use accumulation: for each set that star, that segment's general-use accumulation, then add or subtract one-quadrant degree — subtract for evening appearance and add for morning concealment.
translations.idiomatic: To find Venus and Mercury evening appearance and morning concealment fixed-use accumulation: set each star's segment general-use accumulation, then add or subtract one-quadrant degree — subtract for evening appearance and add for morning concealment.

sentences.zh: 半周天已下自相乘，已上，覆減周天度，餘亦自相乘，二因百約之，滿一百六十七已上，以一百約太陽盈縮分減之，不滿一百六十七者即加之，以其星本伏見度乘之，十五除，為差；

translations.literal: At or below half circuit-of-heaven, self-multiply; above, overturn-subtract circuit-of-heaven degrees, self-multiply the remainder; double and hundred-reduce; if filling 167 or above, subtract one hundred of the solar excess-deficit parts; if below 167, add instead; multiply by that star's base heliacal visibility degree, divide by fifteen — that is the difference;
translations.idiomatic: If at or below half circuit-of-heaven, square the value; if above, subtract from circuit-of-heaven degrees and square the remainder; double and hundred-reduce; if at or above 167 subtract one hundred of the solar excess-deficit parts, otherwise add; multiply by that star's base heliacal visibility degree, divide by fifteen, and obtain the difference;

sentences.zh: 乃置其段初日行分，減去一百分，餘。

translations.literal: Then set that segment's first-day motion parts, subtract one hundred parts; with the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Then subtract one hundred parts from that segment's first-day motion parts, divide the difference by the remainder for days with the remainder as parts, and add or subtract the result from the general-use accumulation — add for evening appearance and subtract for morning concealment.
